name: KunstHausWien
notes: Craft CMS GraphQL API at /api/ (no auth needed). Three sources combined: (1) exhibitions section entries filtered by endDate >= today gives the 2 current temporary exhibitions as single far-end records; (2) a hardcoded permanent record for 'Museum Hundertwasser' (the venue's core permanent collection, data-page="permanentCollection", no published end date -> extra.permanent true); (3) the 'date' entry type gives ~40 dated occurrences (tours/talks/workshops/screenings) which are combined with their parent 'events' section entries for title/url/subtitle. Occurrence date comes from date_Entry.date; time-of-day comes from date_Entry.startTime/endTime falling back to the parent event's startTime/endTime (these carry a bogus placeholder date, only HH:MM is meaningful). No price data anywhere via the API, price_min/price_text always null. Site only publishes ~5 months of dated events ahead (through mid-Feb 2027); horizon_days=180 covers essentially all of it already.
